check_package_installed: check whether a Python package is installed in the current environment
get_package_installed_path: get the installed file system path of a Python package
infer_module_from_package: infer the module name from a Python package using top_level.txt metadata
run_shell_command: run a shell command via subprocess and raise exceptions on failure
install_python_package: install a Python package via pip if it is not already installed
